definitions.early_precision: warnings followed by the labelled failure, at or after the warning step / all warnings
definitions.early_recall: labelled failures (of types the engine has a signal for; the rest are listed in not_covered_failure_types) that had a warning at or before the failing step / all such failures
definitions.lead: labelled failing step minus warning step (0 = warned just before the action, >0 = earlier)
definitions.false_intervention: high/critical warnings whose failure never happened / all high/critical warnings

detection.macro_f1_definition: mean F1 over categories with support>0
detection.fpr_definition: clean scenarios with >=1 finding / clean scenarios

localization.accuracy_definition: exact step match / scenarios with a labelled earliest step (unresolved counts as miss)

outcomes.baseline_definition: Without protection, every scenario labelled with a failure counts as a failed run and every clean scenario counts as a success. This comes from how the scenarios are built; it is not a measurement of a real agent.
outcomes.safe_outcome_definition: run succeeded, or was recovered, or was stopped/escalated before completing a violating action

recovery.definition: recovered / scenarios where an automated recovery was attempted

metrics.cost_note: Deterministic engine only: no paid model calls were made.
